tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Everything sits on ground first.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, code blocks, inputs and tiles placed on ground.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and solid marks on ground and surface (13:1 or more in both themes). Solid fills for realized, native things.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels and control borders on ground and surface (5.9:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between sections only. Below 3:1, so never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: checked
tokens.usage: Proven, passing, closed. Also the focus ring. Text on ground and surface (5.7:1 light, 7.7:1 dark). Always paired with a word or check mark.

tokens.name: on-checked
tokens.usage: Text and marks on a checked fill (6.3:1 light, 7.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: trap
tokens.usage: Runtime traps and rejections only, used small. Text on ground and surface (5.0:1 light, 6.0:1 dark). Always paired with a word or cross mark.

tokens.name: on-trap
tokens.usage: Text and marks on a trap fill (5.6:1 light, 6.0:1 dark).

tokens.name: family-psi
tokens.usage: psi subsystem family. Categorical ownership, not proof or runtime status.

tokens.name: family-psi-surface
tokens.usage: Legible background for the psi subsystem family; use ink for node text.

tokens.name: family-native-surface
tokens.usage: Legible background for the native subsystem family; use ink for node text.

groups.name: Omega Serif
groups.note: Every word in the system: titles, headings, running text, buttons, labels.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The page title, one per page.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A program should be able to keep reading the same data after a call that may pause.
styles.usage: All running text, from a short description to a long guide. At most 68 characters a line.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Small metadata: status words, counts, tile labels, captions.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code, commands and file paths, on surface.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls; between lines of a label group.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Tile padding; between related items.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between groups; page gutter on wide screens.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: radius-stone
tokens.usage: The default corner for every block, tile and panel.

tokens.name: radius-chamfer
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs only, so controls read as touchable.

tokens.name: radius-arch
tokens.usage: Top corners only, to make an arch: status pips, section markers, arch-topped tiles. Never all four corners.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Rules between sections, in rule.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Control edges and outlined (Psi) shapes, in ink-muted or ink.
